faq.question: After Class 12, is it possible for Indian students to explore career in civil engineering in Canada?
faq.answer: Yes. After finishing Class 12, Indian students are eligible to apply as long as they fulfill the academic requirements of the university, which include Physics, Mathematics, and any other necessary courses.

faq.question: What is the duration of a Canadian undergraduate degree in civil engineering?
faq.answer: The majority of undergraduate degrees in civil engineering take four years. Depending on the program format, programs involving internships or co-ops may take longer.

faq.question: Does Canada require IELTS to pursue a career in civil engineering?
faq.answer: Not always. Although acceptable exams, minimum scores, and exemption policies differ, many universities need evidence of English competence. The official requirements of the universities on their short list should be reviewed by applicants.

faq.question: How much does it cost Indian students to study civil engineering in Canada?
faq.answer: With additional housing and personal costs, the annual cost of foreign tuition could be anywhere between CAD 35,000 and CAD 75,000 or more.
